data.name: Bahuj
data.gender_notes: Bahuj is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'B-H-J', meaning 'to give' or 'gift'. This name carries the spiritual significance of being a generous and giving individual in life. The name Bahuj carries the meaning “Gift, Generosity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahuj usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carry the light of generosity and kindness to others.
data.etymology: Bahuj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Generosity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahuj total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: بھوج

in_urdu.name: بھوج

in_hindi.name: बहुज

in_pashto.name: بھوج
